fix_sketch: Optional: clear g3.sentinel when Fm3Remove sees the object at any level; not needed for safety.
why: Level read at 1201 uses saferead rd with -1 default, so no crash; a stale sentinel only shifts the FM3L log line.

fix_sketch: Expire tracks unseen for N seconds in a periodic sweep: clear spinning and emit E1 END.
why: e1Evaluate only runs from AiTraceAttackEntry, so spinning stays true and END is never logged after death or area change; t.cr is never dereferenced stale.

fix_sketch: Store g_lastCtrlArea only when area is non-zero.
why: Line 589 overwrites the baseline with 0 on a transient FnGetArea 0, so the next area change logs no why=area; probe log only.

fix_sketch: Key leader by c0.tag (non-empty, incl. 'player') like companions; keep slot0 only as the fallback.
why: keyFor(0) returns slot0 even though c0.tag is read at 886; after a leader swap the new leader inherits the previous leader's settings.

fix_sketch: Store the server creature in Pending and cancel when v[i].server differs.
why: Pending/auto/cooldown state is slot-indexed with no creature check; a swap inside the 6 s window misattributes DONE/timeout and can allow an early second use.

fix_sketch: Pass a gate-open flag (known true here) to shouldAutoUse instead of the previous frame's seen.
why: Seen is a one-frame-old value; shouldAutoUse's gameplay param takes it (det refutation wrong). Only the first refresh after a hideAll skips, delaying auto by 250 ms.

fix_sketch: Log noneed/pending for companions like the leader branch; closing the popover on a button click is optional UX.
why: Companion LMB at FullHp/Pending falls through silently and leaves the popover open (it stays open on valid clicks too); leader branch logs noneed.

fix_sketch: If the POPOCCLUDE log shows tooltips, setClickable(false) on buttons while inPop; g_nShown is capped at 7 of 8.
why: Hover/click gated by inPop (1134, 1143) but the native tooltip belongs to the engine control; z-order under popover needs runtime data. g_nShown max 7, never exceeds 8.
